API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIData Loss PreventionC2C Incident Receiver Resource Get Receiver By ID
C2C Incident Receiver Resource Get Receiver By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudToCloudIR/:id

Retrieves information about a DLP Incident Receiver configured for Cloud-to-Cloud DLP Incident Forwarding based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

System-generated unique ID of the Cloud-to-Cloud Incident Receiver.

Note: The Incident Receiver's ID can be obtained using the GET /cloudToCloudIR/lite request. This value pertains to the top-level ID of the Incident Receiver returned in the API response and not the configuration-level ID.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated unique ID of the Cloud-to-Cloud DLP Incident Forwarding tenant

name
string

User-provided name for the SaaS application tenant

Possible values: <= 128 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z_0-9-\._]+[a-zA-Z_0-9-\._\s]*$

status
string[]

The status of the tenant

Possible values: [CASB_TENANT_ACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_INACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATING, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_SUCCESS, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_FAIL, CASB_TENANT_NORMAL_RETHORIZATION, CASB_TENANT_CONNECTOR_RETHORIZATION]

modifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the tenant was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
lastTenantValidationTime
int32

Timestamp when the tenant was last validated

lastValidationMsg
object
onboardableEntity
object
REQUIRED
